Remark
[Why shrinking solitons do not satisfy the maximum hypothesis] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0320 1. ch15:15.34\group Ancient Solutions and Solitons

A shrinking sphere, and more generally a shrinking soliton, has scalar curvature tending to infinity at its singular time, so its space-time scalar curvature supremum is not attained.
